prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Draw ONE NEW finished webcomic panel, not a poster, collage, split board or multiple panels. SQUARE image, requested 1024x1024.
Reference 1 is the original drawing/world benchmark. Reference 2 supplies only our newly inspected cast identities, clothing and equipment. Compose the completely new moment described below. Do not reproduce either reference's framing or add its absent characters.

Drawing treatment: Elegant softly modeled pale faces, fine controlled hair edges, desaturated portrait illustration, translucent broad charcoal petals with selective silver filigree. Preserve Intimate beautiful unease and scale contrast between tailored human and floral horror. Avoid Anime conversion, armor clutter, all-over silver threads, dense moss grain, gore and generic haunted-house rubble.
World context: Abandoned curved-rib glasshouse in pale overcast mist. White entrance at LEFT, small caretaker room with a weight-jammed door at RIGHT; broad matte maroon ground, a few pale fallen petals.
VISIBLE subjects in this panel ONLY:
Ilyra Sen: Pale adult woman, elegant oval face, gray eyes, smooth chin-length dark brown bob with ivory nape underlayer. Black split-tail coat, high white collar, dark pleated combat trousers, slim boots. Equipment: One silver single-edge saber with open oval black guard, anatomically RIGHT-handed when drawn. Silver guard on LEFT forearm, small plain silver collar clasp. Current state determines sheathed versus drawn; do not duplicate the saber.
Neris: Light-skinned older female caretaker, long angular nose, gray hair in low knot, plain charcoal dress, faded ivory shawl. Wary and practical. Equipment: Plain iron door key on waist cord, not being used. The caretaker door is weight-jammed, not mechanically locked.
Inspected reference qualification for visible subjects only: Current story state overrides reference pose or charge state.
Visibility/cropping constraints: Only the subjects above, framed as specified below.
ONE current moment: Behind the small door’s upper glass pane Neris pounds once; Ilyra notices her while keeping the flower in peripheral view.
Current physical state (authoritative): Neris enclosed in room, both hands visible on glass; door pinned at bottom by root.
Special visual element, only if specified: none
Camera and framing: Medium over Ilyra’s shoulder, room glass and living face readable. Respect actual subject-to-frame size, especially extreme wides. Do not enlarge a distant person into a medium shot.
Reserve the upper 35% of the image as calm, broad in-world background for later speech balloons. Keep ALL faces, hands, important contact and clue details BELOW that zone. Do not draw balloons or text; the blank space will receive editable lettering.
Draw acting with a specific expression and body intention. For contact, show the physical source/contact/target and its immediate reaction. For a clasp or weapon, make shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand-object ownership legible. Keep supports, scale and visible limb anatomy sound. Do not add later injuries, additional duplicates, alternate weapons, generic glows or undescribed consequences.
Surface design: matte quiet ground, broad deliberate light and shadow shapes, selective purposeful architecture. Group foliage, hair and material marks. Keep medium-defining directional ink/brushwork; avoid pervasive microtexture, repeated tiny facets, flooring crack networks, mirror floors and reflection glitter. Preserve richness through faces, composition and world depth.
No text of any kind, no speech balloons, no glyphs, no captions, no SFX lettering, no UI, no signatures, no watermark, no frame. Exact dialogue will be added separately. Return only the new artwork.
INVENTORY CONTINUITY — This is state information, not a request to add people. Only Ilyra Sen, Neris may appear physically, with the stated crop. Keep Mourning Bloom physically OUTSIDE this frame even if named in possession history. The existing action, camera and explicit nonphysical special elements control what is visible.
Ilyra’s one saber is sheathed; do not place an additional blade in her hand. Coat intact, no premature tear. ONE intact root/foot is PLANTED across room threshold, jamming it with weight. Face orientation stays fixed during each rooted commitment; do not show a separate free head rotating toward Ilyra. No recovered clue packet/button/slip yet in Ilyra’s hands.
COMPOSITION FOR EDITABLE DIALOGUE: Do not change action geometry merely to fit speaker order; identify each balloon after actual art using short attribution and deliberate tail routing. Offscreen voices stay offscreen.
FINAL SHOT PRIORITY: Medium over Ilyra’s shoulder, room glass and living face readable. Depict only this instant: Behind the small door’s upper glass pane Neris pounds once; Ilyra notices her while keeping the flower in peripheral view. No added text or panel division.
